target_behavior: Saves AX via CS, sets ES to 0070h, computes the number of four-byte entries, conditionally decrements it, then writes AX to each entry's segment word; preserves DI and ES and returns near.
current_dependency: Baseline sysinit1.asm still uses a far-call pointer; diagnostic links supply an explicit seg_reinit stub until the DOS 7 initialization path is reconstructed.
limitations: Target call sites and code match the BIOS relocation path, but conditional flag meaning, exact source ownership and runtime behavior remain unresolved. The diagnostic stub is not a target implementation.
